plainText:
(Japanese: の ＥＮＴＥＩ Emperor of the Crystal Tower: Entei) is the adaptation of the movie of the same name. Like other manga adaptations of the s, the manga first appeared in an issue of CoroCoro. The manga was written by Toshio Tanigami.

==Publications==
The manga adaptation of Spell of the Unown: Entei has only ever been published in its original magazine. It has never seen release in a collected volume anywhere in the world.

==Differences between the movie and the manga==
The manga does not include the Hale family's maid, , Schuyler, , , , Nurse Joy, and Officer Jenny.
Molly Hale remains the same age and doesn't transform into an older version of herself to take on and in the manga.
In the manga, Ash's Cyndaquil uses , a move that it would not learn until the episode An Old Family Blend! almost a decade later, and Ash's Totodile uses , a move it has never been seen using in the .
Ash's Charizard does not return from the Charicific Valley to help Ash against in the manga.
